programme.title: The Big Break
programme.desc: After nine weeks of elimination challenges, only two remain to battle it out in match play for a shot at the LPGA Tour. The two rivals have butted heads throughout the series and the mutual disdain should make this a bitter and competitive round.

programme.title: Build a Better Game
programme.desc: Debbie Doniger is here to go through the checkpoints of the golf swing -- from the setup to the top of the backswing. She's got individualized tips and drills for each position to help golfers play their best golf and own their swing.

programme.title: Build a Better Game
programme.desc: Debbie Doniger is back to go through the rest of the checkpoints of the swing -- from the transition through impact. Plus, with this newfound knowledge, she'll help put all the checkpoints together to have golfers swinging their best in no time.

programme.title: Golf Fitness Over 50+
programme.desc: Fitness coach Don Saladino is joined by instructor Debbie Doniger and Vince Cellini for a workout plan aimed at the over 50 golfers that will help to swing faster with more control and less risk of injury.

programme.title: Golf Fitness Over 50+
programme.desc: Fitness coach Don Saladino is joined by instructor Debbie Doniger and Vince Cellini for a workout plan aimed at the over 50 golfers that will help to swing faster with more control and less risk of injury.

programme.title: Glam Golf With Blair O'Neal
programme.desc: Blair joins World Series champion Cody Ross to face NFL Hall of Famer Brian Urlacher and MLB star Mark Mulder in a match of bold moves.

programme.title: Glam Golf With Blair O'Neal
programme.desc: Winter will team up with series host Blair O'Neal to take on Hogle and Pankow in a fierce two-versus-two, shamble match with a twist; each team will be offered two mulligans, but taking a second chance will come with consequences.

programme.title: Glam Golf With Blair O'Neal
programme.desc: Blair O'Neal teams up with Inci Mehmet for a showdown at Portstewart Golf Club's Strand Course in Northern Ireland; their opponents for this 2v2 match are Henni Zuel and Di Stewart, bringing their own flair and competitive fire to this contest.

programme.title: Glam Golf With Blair O'Neal
programme.desc: Blair O'Neal competes against Lucy Robson on the Riverside course at Portstewart Golf Club in Northern Ireland.

programme.title: GolfPass Top Tips
programme.desc: The top tips from the world's best teachers have been compiled to improve your short game; Devan Bonebrake reveals how to make perfect chipping contact, Aimee Cho teaches how a towel can improve your pitch shots and Martin Hall is featured.

programme.title: GolfPass Top Tips
programme.desc: The top tips from the world's best teachers have been compiled to help you out of greenside bunkers; Devan Bonebrake shares Jordan Spieth's sand secret, Nathalie Sheehan teaches a unique grip for bunker shots and James Oh is featured.

programme.title: GolfPass Top Tips
programme.desc: The top instruction tips from Aimee Cho have been compiled to improve your game from tee-to-green; learn the key 3-wood fundamentals, how to crush your longest drives, a secret to the flop shot and how to flush your long irons.

programme.title: GolfPass Top Tips
programme.desc: The top instruction tips from John Montgomery have been compiled to improve your game from tee-to-green; learn how to hit the knockdown shot, make solid wedge contact from tight lies, drive the ball longer and make more putts.

programme.title: GolfPass Top Tips
programme.desc: The top instruction tips from Debbie Doniger have been compiled to improve your game from tee-to-green; learn how to get more distance with the driver, chip the ball closer, improve from greenside bunkers and change your stance for solid contact.

programme.title: Swing Expedition With Chris Como
programme.desc: How Grant Waite became one of the most respected coaches in golf and a deep dive into his swing and his philosophy.

programme.title: Swing Expedition With Chris Como
programme.desc: Chris Como visits with Mike Adams and reveals how to teach the golf swing based on specific body types. Mike demonstrates how the proper grip, backswing, and footwork are decided by your body's measurements.

programme.title: Swing Expedition With Chris Como
programme.desc: Chris Como works out with Joey D, the fitness trainer to golf's longest hitters Dustin Johnson and Brooks Koepka. Learn what band exercises create better body rotation and which medicine ball sequences help increase power.

programme.title: Swing Expedition With Chris Como
programme.desc: George Gankas teaches setup position, backswing and downswing. From Westlake Golf Course in Westlake Village, Calif.

programme.title: Swing Expedition With Chris Como
programme.desc: Chris Como goes to New York to learn how up-and-coming coach Jorge Parada developed the swings of several prominent LPGA Tour players.

programme.title: Swing Expedition With Chris Como
programme.desc: Chris Como joins PGA Tour player Sam Ryder and his coach Adam Schriber in New York. Ryder and Schriber reveal drills they use on the range to keep Sam's game in shape and exercises they deploy in the gym to add speed and flexibility.

programme.title: Swing Expedition With Chris Como
programme.desc: Chris Como heads to Denver to see how GOLFTEC is providing instruction and fitting to the masses and how GOLFTEC instructors utilize technology and data to fit for proper clubs.

programme.title: Swing Expedition With Chris Como
programme.desc: Chris Como travels to Baltusrol Golf Club in New Jersey to learn from Director of Instruction Jason Carbone, including how to improve distance and accuracy, and a trick for instant results.

programme.title: Swing Expedition With Chris Como
programme.desc: Chris Como visits the Leadbetter Golf Academy to learn how instructor David Leadbetter is teaching the next generation of professional golfers; insight from Michelle Wie.

programme.title: Swing Expedition With Chris Como
programme.desc: Chris Como returns to where he began his career more than 20 years ago - Westlake Golf Course, outside Los Angeles. Como visits with the teachers that shaped his career and learns their go-to drills for amateur golfers.

programme.title: Swing Expedition With Chris Como
programme.desc: Multiple-time PGA Tour winner Charles Howell III goes in-depth about his knowledge of the golf swing with his coach and PGA TOUR winner Grant Waite.

programme.title: Swing Expedition With Chris Como

programme.title: Swing Expedition With Chris Como

programme.title: Swing Expedition With Chris Como
programme.desc: Chris Como travels to Austin, Texas and learns from Chuck Cook, the 1996 PGA Teacher of the Year who has worked with Payne Stewart, Tom Kite, and numerous major champions. Cook and Como divide the golf swing into three key sections.

programme.title: Swing Expedition With Chris Como
programme.desc: Chris Como travels to Texas and learns the course management strategies Scott Fawcett teaches through a combination of shot distribution patterns and PGA scoring stats. Learn where to aim off the tee and which type of shot to play out of trouble.
